TITLE:
FlyDubai Co-Pilot Banned by Oman After Near Crash Incident

DESCRIPTION:
FlyDubai co‑pilot who nearly crashed a plane was banned from flying by Oman over extremism concerns. The flight to Tel Aviv was diverted to Tabuk after the pilot was attacked, and passengers stopped a plan to crash the aircraft. #FlyDubai #Oman #AirSafety #Extremism
